{{Conjecture|legends}}
Centuries before the [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a '''corporation''' sent an [[Scout ship/Legends|exploration vessel]] into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] located the [[O'reen system/Legends|O'reen system]] and the inhabitable [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]]. The [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] aboard the vessel attempted to claim O'reen for their employer through a display of technological know-how, but the native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[O'reenian]]s, fought them off and stole their starship. The confrontation convinced the [[Unidentified Magnus (scout encounter)|Magnus]], or planetary leader, to modernize O'reen's military.<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
